operations.description: After a successful login, the client should send a `GET` call approximately once an hour to refresh the user data.
operations.summary: Get the latest state information about the logged-in user
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] user [PATH] user [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] 401 document with

operations.description: After a successful call, this returns a User document with an updated list of affiliations.
operations.summary: Update the following status of the logged-in user for a particular aggregation
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] following [PATH] following [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] 400 401 affiliation document with

operations.description:
This can and should only be used by clients who have access to the `temporary_user` grant type.
    Third-party developers do not have access to this grant type by default, and will not need this endpoint.
operations.summary: Copy listening data from a temporary user account to the logged-in user's account
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] inherit from temp user [PATH] user inherit [PARAMS] authorization temp user [SCHEMA] 400 document with

operations.description: Right now, only the primary station can be changed. Previously selected stations will not be deleted, but the new station will be moved to first in the array.
operations.summary: Update the logged-in user's favorite station(s)
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] update stations [PATH] stations [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] 400 401 document with
